pattern.name: full_page_audit
pattern.description: Audit all pages of a web app for visual/functional issues

steps.step: browser_snapshot (get page structure and nav links)

For each nav link found in snapshot: - browser_click target="{ref}" element="Nav link: {name}" - browser_wait_for time=1 - browser_take_screenshot filename="0{N}-{page-name}.png" fullPage=true - browser_console_messages level="error"

pattern.name: form_interaction
pattern.description: Fill and submit a form, verify result

steps.step: browser_snapshot (find form fields and submit button)

pattern.name: modal_dialog
pattern.description: Trigger and interact with a modal

steps.step: browser_click target="{trigger-ref}" element="Button that opens modal"
If hamburger found: browser_click → browser_take_screenshot filename="mobile-menu-open.png"

pattern.name: contrast_extraction
pattern.description: Extract WCAG contrast data for all text elements
